name: Git Pulse
author: Omarchy
description: Branch and dirty counts of the focused terminal's git repository

barWidget.description: Shows the branch plus staged/modified/untracked counts of the git repo in the focused terminal's working directory. Hidden outside git repositories.

schema.label: Show untracked
schema.description: Append ?N for untracked files to the label. Off by default to keep the pill slim.

schema.label: Show ahead/behind
schema.description: Append up/down arrows with commits ahead of and behind the upstream branch.
